column1: # Human-audited verdicts for flags the generator could only call "referenced".
# The generator reads tokens. It cannot see evidence that arrives through a
# config-file equivalent, a golden file, or a library-level test, so it
# understates. These rows are what a person found by reading the tests.
#   behavior     a test asserts an observable effect; it fails if the flag stops working
#   parse-only   a test drives it through clap and asserts nothing downstream
#   mention-only the token appears; nothing exercises it
